description: The ChinaPV research team publishes mapped solar-photovoltaic installations with coverage across China for 2015 and 2020. The dataset combines Landsat-based random-forest classification with visual inspection and boundary refinement. WGS84 shapefiles contain installation identifiers, centre coordinates, area, perimeter, province and urban or rural location labels; test samples are also deposited. Zenodo access is public and free under CC BY 4.0. These inventories can support siting, land-use and exposure simulations in platform-qgis and inform electricity planning with model-pypsa. A caveat is that mapped panel area is not installed electrical capacity or actual generation. Small or visually ambiguous installations can be missed, and the two snapshots do not identify exact commissioning dates. Overall reported accuracy does not replace local checks. No vector files or validation samples were downloaded.
